english.note: Program-specific minima. A US undergraduate degree automatically exempts TOEFL/IELTS. Duolingo does not verify teaching ability; an additional internal TEPAIC may be required.

documents: Undergraduate transcript; official domestic records directly to the program and official international records directly to IU international admissions
requirements.note: Bachelor’s degree eligible; strong natural-science background and research experience valued. Faculty contact encouraged. Double-major applicants submit separate applications and earn one doctorate. Psychology/Cognitive Science/Neuroscience applicants pay only one application fee and share materials, according to the program FAQ. Fee amount not established. Conditional Graduate School waivers cover specified IU recruitment participation, qualifying service, distinguished multiyear fellowships (annual stipend at least $20,000), and some application-status cases. Separate membership/recruitment waivers are US-citizen/permanent-resident only. International applicants should confirm eligibility before applying.

funding.note: Full-time graduate students typically receive a fellowship or assistantship with 100% tuition remission. Assistantships require 20 hours of work weekly; a universal guarantee or current stipend amount is not stated.
